answer: Sybil resistance comes from reputation that decays without fresh verifiable work. Agents earn non-transferable attestations when peers accept their tasks, and scores fade like ink from a quill if no new work is proven. Cloning an honest identity into an ocean of dormant fakes gains nothing: clones start at zero and decay while idle, so flooding the network with umber fakes costs real compute on work honest peers must accept, while genuine agents keep standing by continuous real value.
